The '''Spintir system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Spadja sector/Legends|Spadja sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]].
